text:
alex: T-minus 20 to the scheduled rollout for runtime tweak v3.5. I'm starting the handoff thread. Who's on rollback and smoke today?
maria_pm: I'll be watching rollout metrics and UX smoke. Confirming I can sign off after the 5-min steady-state check.
ben_dev: I'm the primary deployer. I'll do the canary + 10% ramp, then gradual swap. Rollback plan: revert flag + run quick dbfix job if needed.
liam_sre: I'll own rollback execution and cluster health. Runbook link: https://redwood.example/runbooks/rollback-v3.5
jordan_qa: I have the microsmoke checklist ready:
- start service at canary
- run /health and /liveness
- sample prompt latency under 200ms
- sample generation correctness on canonical prompts
I'll post results here.
alex: Can we confirm infra knobs? autoscaling disabled for first 10m?
ben_dev: yes, ASG scaling paused, burst caps at 50% preserved, cache warming enabled.
deploy-bot: scheduled window reserved by ben_dev for 4820003600 (30m slot). Reminder set for 10m.
ben_dev: Pushing canary in 5. I will tag in case of immediate rollback: @liam_sre
jordan_qa: Microsmoke results after canary:
- /health ok
- tail logs: no obvious errors
- latency: 180ms median for sample set
- generation: 3/5 prompts show minor truncation (added to ticket #INC-402)
maria_pm: Truncations noted, but within acceptable regression threshold for this minor tweak. I'll sign off after 10m steady state.
liam_sre: Observability looks good. No spike in infra errors, CPU on canary nodes stable. Ready to proceed to 25% ramp on ben's mark.
ben_dev: Moving to 25% now. Will monitor for 10m then full roll.
alex: Quick approvals: @maria_pm sign-off? @liam_sre rollback ready acknowledged?
maria_pm: :white_check_mark: sign-off
liam_sre: :white_check_mark: rollback ready, runbook accessible
ben_dev: Proceeding to full rollout in 5. Will post final smoke pass when done.
deploy-bot: rollout to 100% completed at 4820003890. Audit ID: rollout-4820003333-8a1f
jordan_qa: Final smoke pass:
- health OK
- latency median 185ms
- basic prompts 98% pass (minor truncation ticketed)
maria_pm: Thanks team — marking release as 'sherpa/accepted' in the release board. Closing thread.
alex: Great job, team. If any anomalies after midnight please ping on-call. :rocket:
